name: HMC Capital Limited
summary: HMC Capital Limited, together with its subsidiaries, owns and manages real asset focused funds in Australia. It operates through Real Estate, Private Equity, Private Credit, and Digital Infrastructure segments. The company invests in high-conviction and scalable real assets across real estate, private credit, energy transition, and digital infrastructure strategies. The company was formerly known as Home Consortium Limited. HMC Capital Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
